decisions.reason: The source specifies wording for the coded-referral mint-success modal; it does not change the FAQ content or underlying referral explanation.
The source changes post-mint feedback wording, not whether or which NFT asset is minted and delivered.
The coded-referral success-modal wording does not alter the landing-page hero copy.
The source concerns an in-app mint-success modal and does not change certificate or confirmation-email behavior or content.
The source explicitly addresses a mint where a referral code is used; the no-code random reward package remains unchanged.
The source defines post-mint success feedback, not the distinct pre-mint valid-code or invalid-code validation messages.
The modal repeats the existing $5 commission and ticket outcome but does not change the mint price or revenue allocation.
The source does not change the fiat provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, or mint-delivery flow.
The source changes user-facing success wording and does not modify how commissions or tickets are recorded on accounting surfaces.
Awarding a draw ticket is mentioned descriptively, but the source does not change winner eligibility, weighting, randomness, or draw execution.
The source applies only to the coded-referral mint-success modal and does not revise landing-page mechanics or prize-section messaging.
The source does not change which NFT metadata attributes or counters are exposed; it only specifies modal text.
